in_marathi.name: Narendrakumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the people
in_marathi.long_meaning: Narendrakumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Narendra is a compound name composed of two words: Narendra and Kumar. Narendra is derived from the Sanskrit words 'nara' meaning 'man' and 'indra' meaning 'king' or 'lord'. Kumar means 'son of'. Thus, Narendrakumar can be translated as 'Son of the king or lord of the people'.
